$comment: App version and build number (Task 4A.2). Single source for the Android versionName/versionCode, the iOS MARKETING_VERSION/CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION and the version shown in the app. Increase build_number for every APK given to anyone (including the owner); never reuse one. After editing run `npm run version:bundle`. Separate from config/brand.json (the product name may change; versions do not restart).
